summary: Pastes can have a view limit. The upload accepts views=1..1000 and stores maxViews and viewsRemaining in the paste metadata. Each content read in the storage layer uses one view; the read that uses the last view deletes the paste. HEAD and metadata reads do not use a view. Limited pastes send Cache-Control: no-store. Unlimited pastes do not change.

intent.objective: Add view-limited pastes: store a view limit, use one view on each content read, and delete the paste after the last view.

contractChanges.explanation: A content read of a limited paste uses one view and can delete the paste. Reads of unlimited pastes, HEAD requests, and metadata reads have no side effects.
Upload and metadata responses add maxViews and viewsRemaining for limited pastes. Both fields are absent for unlimited pastes.
The upload accepts views, an integer from 1 to 1000. Any other value gets 400.
Limited pastes send Cache-Control: no-store, because a cached copy lets a reader skip a view. Unlimited pastes stay public.

preservedInvariants: Upload, read, HEAD, metadata, and delete of unlimited pastes do not change.
HEAD requests and metadata reads do not use a view.
Old metadata without view fields reads as an unlimited paste.
